question: How did the author attribute the illumination of this work to both others’ help and personal effort?
premises: Others did something for the author
The author identifies himself as the agent of illumination
inference: This illumination arose through others’ contribution and was brought forth by the author.
uncertainties: The exact nature of what others did is unspecified.
plain_english: They did something for me; thereupon this was illumined by me.
